description: This file defines a Razor ViewComponent named 'Basket' that manages the display and interaction logic for a shopping basket in an e-commerce web application. It interacts with services to count basket items, handles signed-in and anonymous users, and retrieves basket identifiers from cookies.

classes.name: Basket
classes.description: A ViewComponent class that renders the shopping basket summary, manages user authentication state, and retrieves basket item count based on user identity or anonymous cookies.

methods.name: InvokeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates and returns the basket view model with the total item count.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Counts total items in the basket for signed-in users or anonymous users based on cookies.

methods.name: GetAnnonymousIdFromCookie
methods.description: Retrieves the anonymous basket ID stored in browser cookies, if available and valid.
